name: SVR Poker Android
updateMessage: An optional SVR Poker Android update is available.
updateMenuPolicy: Hidden unless releaseReady is true, apkUrl is non-empty, and apkVersionCode is newer than the installed code.
notes: Phase 348 instantiates the selected Eric or Claudia profile avatar inside Android, Quest, and PC gameplay.
The avatar uses the Phase 341 canonical south/front seat and follows the local player rig while standing.
While seated, the body remains fixed at seat zero and the head or neck follows the player's view within safe limits.
The runtime prevents duplicate local player roots and removes duplicate Phase 348 avatar instances automatically.
FBX and GLB bodies are supported, with a lightweight procedural fallback when an asset cannot load.
Android is capped at 24 pose updates per second, 18 animation updates per second, and six equipment meshes.
Quest is capped at 30 pose updates per second, 24 animation updates per second, and five equipment meshes.
Desktop is capped at 60 pose updates per second, 30 animation updates per second, and eight equipment meshes.
Camera 3 remains free of player account, profile avatar, and in-game avatar modules.
Phase 347 single-controller, seated movement, card visibility, logo, pot display, and full-hand controls remain preserved.
No native Android wrapper source, signing identity, or installable APK is currently present in the repository.
Forced updates and recurring update prompts remain disabled.
